# The relocated subject-prefix gtest retains three assertion sites without messages

The inspected subject-prefix gtest checks preference setup, each numeric helper result and the final allTestsPassed flag with EXPECT_TRUE and no streamed message. Its nearby printf is separate from the assertion. Add a nonempty expected-behavior message when changing these assertion sites, with the test case or expected result where useful. The historical R100 relocation preserves the older test bytes; the accepted test later has a different name, API and input cases. This is a scoped diagnostic finding, with no GTest or CI execution.

Scope: mailnews/base/test/gtest.
